title: Review system design for testability
description:
Analyze current architecture and identify testability challenges and opportunities for improvement.

Current state:
- Operations directly use Storage and JJ without abstraction
- Hard to test commands without affecting real .pebbles directory
- No dependency injection or trait-based abstractions
- Business logic mixed with I/O in some places

Areas to investigate:
- Can we introduce traits for Storage and JJ to enable mock implementations?
- Should Operations accept trait objects instead of concrete types?
- Where can we separate pure business logic from I/O effects?
- What testing patterns work well for CLI applications?

Deliverable: Document with analysis of current testability, concrete recommendations for improvements, and priorities for implementation.
